ext_desc.message: Sends browser downloads and on-page video/audio to Kami: fast downloads, on-video button, context menu.

popup_offline.message: Kami is closed. Downloads stay in the browser.

popup_nohost.message: The bridge isn't installed. Run native_host\kur_host.bat in the Kami folder.

popup_alt_hint.message: Hold Alt while clicking to let the browser download the file.

popup_media_none.message: No video/audio caught yet. Play the video and it shows up here.

cloud_personal_hint.message: Kami: this is your personal drive. Open the file/folder's share link to download it.

rd_ok_torrent.message: Added to Real-Debrid; Kami downloads it when ready.

rd_ok_queued.message: Passed through Real-Debrid and queued in Kami.

rd_ok_pending.message: Sent; Real-Debrid is slow to answer — the result will show in Kami.

rd_err_rd_infringing.message: Real-Debrid refuses this content due to a copyright block (RD's own block).

rd_err_rd_too_many.message: Too many active downloads on Real-Debrid.

rd_err_rd_premium.message: This needs a Real-Debrid premium account.

rd_err_rd_unsupported.message: This hoster isn't supported by Real-Debrid.

rd_err_rd_unavailable.message: The file is missing on the hoster.

rd_err_rd_hoster_down.message: The hoster is in maintenance or unreachable.

rd_err_rd_hoster_limit.message: Real-Debrid's daily limit for this hoster is reached.

rd_err_rd_torrent_big.message: The torrent is too big for Real-Debrid.

rd_err_rd_not_allowed.message: Real-Debrid doesn't allow this file type.

rd_err_rd_already.message: Already active in the Real-Debrid account.

rd_err_rd_slow.message: Too many requests to Real-Debrid; wait a bit.
